nodes.summary: Let $\Gamma$ be a subgroup of $\mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$. A function $f \colon \mathbb{H} \to \mathbb{C}$ on the upper half-plane is invariant under $\Gamma$ when $f(\gamma \cdot \tau) = f(\tau)$ for every $\gamma \in \Gamma$ and every $\tau \in \mathbb{H}$, where $\gamma$ acts on $\mathbb{H}$ by Möbius transformations.
nodes.title: Invariance under a subgroup of the modular group

nodes.summary: A function $f \colon \mathbb{H} \to \mathbb{C}$ on the upper half-plane is meromorphic at the cusps when, for every $\gamma \in \mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$, the function $\tau \mapsto f(\gamma \cdot \tau)$ is meromorphic at infinity, where $\gamma$ acts on $\mathbb{H}$ by Möbius transformations.
nodes.title: Meromorphy at the cusps

nodes.summary: A function $f \colon \mathbb{H} \to \mathbb{C}$ on the upper half-plane is meromorphic at infinity when there are a positive integer $N$ and a function $g \colon \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ meromorphic at $0$ such that $f(\tau) = g(e^{2 \pi i \tau / N})$ for every $\tau \in \mathbb{H}$ with sufficiently large imaginary part.
nodes.title: Meromorphy at infinity

nodes.summary: A function $f \colon \mathbb{H} \to \mathbb{C}$ on the upper half-plane is meromorphic when there is a function $g \colon \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ that is meromorphic on the open set $\{z \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{Im} z > 0\}$ and satisfies $g(\tau) = f(\tau)$ for every $\tau \in \mathbb{H}$.
nodes.title: Meromorphy on the upper half-plane

nodes.summary: Let $\Gamma$ be a subgroup of $\mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$. A function $f \colon \mathbb{H} \to \mathbb{C}$ on the upper half-plane is a modular function for $\Gamma$ when it is meromorphic on $\mathbb{H}$, invariant under $\Gamma$, and meromorphic at the cusps.
nodes.title: Modular functions

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
